permitDetails.facilityAddress: COLOGIX NNJ1, 1719 Rt 10 E, Ste 111, Parsippany, Morris County
permitDetails.rightOfEntryClause: The Department and its representatives have the right to enter and inspect any facility or property in accordance with N.J.A.C. 7:27-1.31(a)1-8; No person shall obstruct, hinder or delay the Department or its representatives in its exercise of its rights.
permitDetails.extractionNotes: Permit Activity ID listed as primary permit identifier. Facility ID/Program Interest No. is 26665.

generatorSets.fuelGrade: Diesel; Number two fuel oil (No. 2); kerosene (per GP-005A applicability)
generatorSets.fuelChangePermitTrigger: This general permit cannot be used to register an emergency generator that combusts fuels other than No. 2 fuel oil, diesel and kerosene; new, additional or replacement sources require a new general permit registration.
generatorSets.allowedOperatingModes: The emergency generator(s) specified in the permit shall be operated only under the following situations: (a) During the performance of normal testing and maintenance procedures, as recommended in writing by the manufacturer, facility SOP, and/or as required by law (except on days when the Department forecasts air quality "unhealthy" or worse); (b) When there is a power outage or the facility's primary source fails because of an emergency; or (c) When there is a voltage reduction issued by PJM and posted on the PJM website.
generatorSets.extractionNotes: Primary fuel and fuel-grade fields populated from GP-005A applicability text rather than unit-specific line in equipment table.
